[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on how to choose the best combination of veggies for stir-fry, including:  
- Aim for a colorful variety of veggies.  
- Combine veggies with different textures.  
- Balance sweet, savory, and umami flavors.  
- Choose veggies with similar cooking times.  
- Use seasonal and local veggies.  
- Include personal preferences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested popular veggie combinations for stir-fry:  
- Classic: broccoli, bell peppers, carrots, onions, and mushrooms  
- Asian-inspired: snow peas, bell peppers, mushrooms, cabbage, and bok choy  
- Summer vibes: zucchini, yellow squash, cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, and onions  
- Winter warmth: sweet potatoes, Brussels sprouts, carrots, and red cabbage  
[USER] The user decided to try the classic combination of broccoli, bell peppers, carrots, onions, and mushrooms for their stir-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on how to cook the veggies for the stir-fry to achieve a tender-crisp texture, including:  
- Cut veggies into uniform sizes.  
- Use medium-high heat.  
- Add oil and aromatics first.  
- Add veggies in batches based on cooking times.  
- Stir-fry technique and not overcooking.  
- Season to taste.  
[USER] The user expressed interest in adding garlic and ginger to their stir-fry for extra flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested various stir-fry sauces beyond soy sauce and hoisin sauce, including:  
- Oyster sauce  
- Sesame oil and soy sauce

- Sriracha and soy sauce  
- Peanut sauce  
- Kung Pao sauce

[USER] The user decided to make their own peanut sauce with peanuts, soy sauce, garlic, and chili peppers.
